create_Ccd_with_user_ccd: create a Ccd instance with a custom user CCD string to override default chemical components
lookup_component_info: lookup a chemical component by residue name using component_name_to_info and return its ComponentInfo
get_element_type_symbol: get the element type symbol for a given residue and atom name using type_symbol
convert_mmcif_to_info: convert an mmCIF mapping to a ComponentInfo dataclass using mmcif_to_info
iterate_ccd_entries: iterate over all chemical component keys in a Ccd instance using its Mapping interface
